title: Expanding the PRAAS spectrum: De novo mutations of immunoproteasome subunit β-type 10 in six infants with SCID-Omenn syndrome

reviewer.method: Personally read complete 16-page held publisher-version main PDF layout text (961 splitlines), all51references, all four numbered figures and graphical abstract, and both main tables including every cell/footnote and upright Table1 continuation. Read complete19-page DocumentS1 text(692 splitlines): all six detailed case reports, all methods,17references, both supplementary figures and all four supplementary tables in full text and pixels. Read all six assigned packets including four alternates,134phenotype entries and six alleles. Combined34-page DocumentS2 contains exactly the same text and rendered pixels as personally read main pages2–16 plus S1pages1–19; mechanical identity receipt is not an automated reading claim. No inherited canonical overwritten.

audit.exposure_note: Required HANDOFF reading exposed aggregate history and a historical public-control HG002/FGFR2 case-specific rank. No target-case inference ranks, inference-output files or benchmark outcome summaries consulted. This review is not blinded.
